parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL1075189 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Use an INNER JOIN to compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
